findings_qualitative.value: AGN have only marginal effects on CO, [CI] luminosities, excitation, gas and dust fractions

evidence.quote: we find only marginal effects of the presence and strength of AGN on the carbon monoxide CO ($J=2,4,5,7$) or neutral carbon

claims.hypothesis: AGN alter gas excitation and reservoirs in IR-selected z~1.2 galaxies
claims.experiment: Compare CO/[CI] luminosities, ratios and mean SLEDs of AGN hosts vs star-forming galaxies
claims.result: No significant differences except higher CO(7-6) tied to starbursts
claims.finding: AGN have minimal effects on gas

evidence.quote: we do not retrieve any significant departure in terms of various CO and \[C I\] line luminosities or their ratios, excitation conditions and SLEDs up to $J=7$

claims.hypothesis: AGN contribute to CO(5-4) beyond star formation
claims.experiment: Linear fit of L'CO(5-4) with L_IR,SFR and L_IR,AGN
claims.finding: AGN may explain a few outliers

evidence.quote: it decreases the intrinsic scatter of the standard $L_{\rm IR,\,SFR}$-$L'_{\rm CO(5-4)}$ relation by 17%
